utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there Saturday with my old tools, should be good to have something to focus on.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Uli. Bring 'em by my garage Friday night so I can sort what we'll work on.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I'll drop them off Friday evening. Thanks for organizing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Kira! Rosa and I are pulling it together—I've already got a bunch of tools sorted. Want to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so Rosa's actually in charge? I thought Sam mentioned something about it too—are we sure everyone's on the same page here?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Rosa and I have been coordinating—I've been handling the supplies side. It's all coming together, just needs a few more hands!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I hear we're organizing a repair drive. Need any help coordinating?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Sam, yes! It's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center now—can you help spread the word and maybe manage the sign-in table?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sunday at the community center, got it! I'll put up some flyers and grab a clipboard for the sign-in table—happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let me check my notes — the repair drive starts at 9 AM sharp this Saturday. I've got Gus bringing a solid drill, a level, hammers, and wrenches, so we're well-equipped.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect, that sounds like a good setup. Have you had a chance to look at the error log yet? I want to make sure we're on the same page before we start.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven't checked the error log yet, Hana. Let me pull it up now so we can go through it together before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Opal, I've got my garage all cleared out and ready for Saturday morning—just let me know if you need me to mark it on the map as a collection point.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That's perfect, Mara! Yes, I'll have Sam mark your garage as a collection point—it'll be a great help for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Opal! I'll make sure the garage is clearly labeled so folks can find it easily.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I think it's Saturday—just planning to swing by with my toaster quick.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, that's what I thought! Wait, or was it Sunday? I swear I wrote it down... somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, pretty sure it's Saturday—I'm just gonna show up with my toaster and hope for the best.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hana, before we dive in, did you catch the error log? It might save us some guesswork.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven't seen any error log, Dane — I'm still trying to sort out whether we're fixing the playground or the community center roof first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, wait—are we not all working on the same thing? I thought we were tackling appliances or something Jules mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, do you have the exact time for the repair drive this Saturday? I want to make sure I'm clear on the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I heard it's this Saturday, starting at 10 AM sharp! I was just telling Cleo about it earlier.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, 10 AM works for me. Do we need to bring our own tools or will the community center provide them?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'd suggest we make a list of what everyone’s bringing—that way we can be sure we’ve got the right parts on hand before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great idea, Pia! I'll start a spreadsheet and share it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, a spreadsheet—that's perfect! Could you add a column for estimated repair time too? That way we can schedule drop-offs so nobody's waiting around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Tess, do you know if they'll have tools on hand or should we bring our own stuff?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, they've got a whole box of tools, but I heard if you have specialty ones, it's good to label 'em and bring 'em along!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know — I'll bring my set of small screwdrivers, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Faye, do you know if the repair drive is still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's set for Saturday—I'm hoping that works well for everyone with school events out of the way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, glad to hear it's still on. I'll be there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, you said you'd bring stuff over. That sounds great. Hey, have you seen my old hedge clippers anywhere?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Those old rusty things? I think I saw 'em leaning against your garage last week, but I can grab my electric trimmer if you need it for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Electric trimmer, huh? That might be handier. Wait, what was I gonna use them for again?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Dane! Perfect timing—I just heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. Can we still count on your help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, moved to Sunday? That works even better for me—yeah, I'm still in!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Dane! That's such a relief—I'll put you down for general repairs, if that suits you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, pretty sure it's Saturday. I'm just gonna drop by with my toaster, see if they can fix it quick.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you Saturday. I'll add your toaster to the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cool, thanks Leo. I'll see you then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Friday evening works for me. I'll bring by a few of my most reliable tools and we can see what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's perfect, Gus! I've got that wobbly chair and broken toaster I mentioned—hoping your tools can work their magic.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'll take a look at that chair and toaster for sure—I've fixed plenty of those before.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I was just talking to Mina about that — she seemed pretty keen to start, but I'm hearing different things about what it's for. Are we doing the community center or the playground?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It's both, actually — we're tackling the community center first, then moving over to the playground if we have time. I've got it all mapped out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's a relief — I was worried folks were pulling in different directions. So Mina's on board with that plan?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so are you confirming I'm actually organizing this repair drive now? Because I'm still getting mixed signals.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I think Mara and Hana are getting it together—I'm just helping with the schedule. Saturday works best for the school pickup, so I'm sticking with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so Mara and Hana are the ones—thanks for clearing that up. I was starting to think I'd lost my mind.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Pia, I saw you had some old tools in your garage—any chance you'd want to donate them for the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I do have a few things, but I'm worried about whether they'll have the right spare parts. Did you see a list of what they can actually fix?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a list right here—let me show you what we're working with, so you can see exactly what parts are needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there Saturday morning, bright and early.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Uli! I'll have the coffee ready and a spot cleared for sorting.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, I'll see you then. Mind if I bring my old toolbox? It's got a few things that might be useful.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Opal! I'm rallying everyone for a playground repair drive this Saturday—want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've actually been organizing a neighborhood repair drive for Saturday too—Marcus's garage is the main drop-off spot. Want to combine efforts?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that's perfect! Let's merge our plans—I've got folks ready to fix the playground, and your drop-off spot could gather supplies. Saturday's going to be huge!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, do we have a confirmed start time for Saturday yet? I don't want to show up too early or too late.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We're kicking off at 10 a.m., Mina—that way everyone has time to grab coffee and still get an early start on fixing things up!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, 10 a.m. it is. Who's heading up the sign-in table?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes Tess, we're all set for Saturday! I'll bring my toolbox and can coordinate the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's wonderful, Mara! I knew you'd be the perfect person to spearhead this—everyone's been buzzing about it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess! And I hear Gus has tools we can borrow—he's really stepped up too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard it's to fix the community center roof. Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the community center roof? I thought it was something else... but yeah, I'll probably go if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm glad you're going—maybe we can remind each other when it gets closer.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, let's pull it up together and go through it step by step.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Step by step... right, I should probably write that down too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good idea, Oren. It’s always better to have notes so we don’t miss anything.
